metadata.chronas:note: Token-free replacement for mapbox://styles/mapbox/satellite-v9. EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless, no API key required. We deliberately use the 's2cloudless_3857' (2016) mosaic because it is CC BY 4.0; every later year (2017+ except 2017 itself) is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, which would impose a NonCommercial restriction. Imagery age is irrelevant for a historical atlas.
metadata.chronas:tile-axis-order: WMTS RESTful is {TileMatrix}/{TileRow}/{TileCol}, i.e. {z}/{y}/{x} - not {z}/{x}/{y}. Verified empirically.
